comparisons.detail: Three coding fixtures, three repetitions each. The initial Jackalope build is compared with the native CLI directly. This establishes the starting overhead.

discovery.measurement: Authored tool-description ranking only, 32 candidates maximum, no agent execution, cold application cache. Recall at five and empty results for absent capabilities. No agent-token savings, end-to-end latency improvement or general accuracy claim.
discovery.comparison: The same authored queries and fixed promotion threshold were used before and after adding the local-page bypass. The two runs were sequential, not interleaved; remote service latency is uncontrolled. Skipped requests have known zero API input usage. This measures avoided Jev calls, not downstream agent savings.

experiments.title: Task-scoped guidance with structured reads
experiments.detail: One authored extraction task, two repetitions per variant. The same native CLI control and structured-read configuration, with opt-in Balanced guidance that limits call-site investigation to code changes. Applicable repository guidance and checks remain required. Selected after observing unnecessary exploration in the earlier pilot; not held-out confirmation.

blockers: Require at least 50 distinct tasks and 20 independent source families for the product claim gate.
A frozen, held-out confirmation run is required.
Independent quality acceptance of the original patches is incomplete.
Quality uncertainty does not rule out a two-percentage-point regression; this is a reporting tolerance, not a guarantee.
No measured time or conservatively estimated total-cost improvement with a lower confidence bound of at least 10%.
Replication, resource and cache conditions must be recorded.

report.limitations: All completed and failed attempts remain in totals. The claim gate concerns agent execution; human review and correction time are optional, separate delivery measurements. Independent acceptance assesses the original patch before corrections. Cost uses explicit API-equivalent prices, not subscription billing or quota. When cumulative usage cannot identify long-context request tiers, costs are bounded and the improvement uses baseline low versus candidate high. Cache-write prices must describe an incremental charge when writes are already in input. No human acceptance is inferred from agent claims or tests. Related seeded defects share one source-family cluster. p95 is omitted below 20 measured trials. This report never authorizes publication.

protocol.resourceLimits: One live agent trial at a time on the same development PC; no concurrent builds. Normal desktop activity is not isolated.
protocol.cachePolicy: Fresh task workspace and application process; inherited provider caching and remote service load. Standard API price equivalents do not establish the delivered service tier.

experiments.title: Native CLI control for structured tool reads
experiments.detail: One authored extraction task, two repetitions per variant. Both sides receive the exact tool name, empty arguments and requested JSON pointer. Jackalope offers named read, local field selection and available-tool exposure; the native CLI uses the direct MCP server. Configuration selected after earlier ablations; this is screening, not held-out confirmation.

screeningStatus.reason: User requested early futility stop and product iteration. Completed unfavorable results retained.
screeningStatus.methodology: Adaptive exploratory screening; neither fixed-sample inference nor held-out confirmation. All completed receipts retained; interrupted usage unknown.

routingAssessment.scope: Production Jev request and selection logic with unknown capacity and no accepted-cost history. Selection alone is not downstream quality or savings evidence.
routingAssessment.conditions: Sourced model facts, unknown provider capacity and no independently accepted cost history; not an end-to-end routed-worker comparison. Six calls ran alongside one agent benchmark process; no concurrent build.
